<!-- Repository-level instructions for GitHub Copilot -->

## Repository Context
This repository is a personal learning space focused on experimenting with AI-assisted coding, small exercises, and prompt engineering.

## Preferred Behavior
- Prefer concise, well-explained code snippets.
- Suggest minimal, testable implementations first.
- When proposing opinionated choices, list alternatives with tradeoffs.

## Style Guidelines
- Follow simple, readable code style and idiomatic patterns for the language used.
- Keep functions small and well-named.

## Prompts and Tasks
- When the user runs `/init` or asks to scaffold a project, propose a minimal working structure and explain each file's role.

## Safety
- Never suggest inserting secrets or personal API keys into files.
